title: Repeat Returned Payments Within Twelve Months — Fee Multiplier
content:
On Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts, a repeat-return multiplier follows the returned payments on the contract dated fewer than 12 whole months before the assessment date, the return being charged included.

## Points of judgement

| Returned payments in the window (the charged one included) | Treatment |
|---|---|
| three or more | the returned-payment fee for the registration state plus the returned-amount add-on is multiplied by the third-return multiplier, 2.0 |
| exactly two | that same sum is multiplied by the second-return multiplier, 1.5 |
| one | the sum is charged as it stands |

## Counting the window

A return counts when fewer than 12 whole months separate its date from the assessment date; a month is whole once the same day of the month is reached. Hypothetical: for an assessment on 2026-10-05, a return dated 2025-10-06 is 11 whole months back and counts; a return dated 2025-10-05 is 12 whole months back and does not.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Registration-state fee 30.00, add-on 5.00, two returns in the window: 35.00 multiplied by 1.5 is 52.50.
- Registration-state fee 35.00, no add-on, three returns in the window: 35.00 multiplied by 2.0 is 70.00.
- Registration-state fee 25.00, add-on 10.00, only the return being charged: 35.00 as it stands.
